Name: Captain Sardax

Name: Boatswain Tarto
Key Details (Player):
• [S01] Revealed the Moonraider battle was a simulation of Sardax's doomed final stand, never meant to be won
• [S01] Praised each cadet's strengths and issued their assignments

• [S01] Named by Mr. Blip as a great spelljammer of Caelestis in years past
• [S02] Oriented the new cadet Bartholomew, telling him being a wilder changed nothing aboard a crew, and pointed him to the Weeping Goddess
• [S02] Told cadets they needed no simulation chamber to practice and took them to the Nexus, sending for Saerthe
• [S02] Ran the salvage simulation briefing alongside Saerthe
• [S03] Moved through the wreckage of the simulation chamber ushering the injured out, and received the recovered rod from Gregory
• [S03] Conferred with Saerthe over the rod and its marking, Vocath

Name: Sorcur
Key Details (Player):
• [S01] Greeted the cadets in administration with a voice that entered their minds instead of their ears
• [S01] Issued packets, vouchers, and temporary access stars
Current State: Working administration at Caelestis.
Overview (Player): Sorcur is a thri-kreen receptionist in Caelestis's administration whose voice enters the mind directly. She issues the packets, vouchers, and access stars that govern the academy's layered order.

Name: Veena
Key Details (Player):
• [S01] Tried to take Boogie's corner bunk before he had settled in, then backed off when Sol stepped in behind him
• [S02] Assigned with Miken, Barret, and the rest of their squad to the salvage race from the opposite chamber
• [S03] Injured in the arcane blast that wrecked the simulation chamber, and lay bandaged and unconscious but breathing in the infirmary
Current State: Recovering unconscious in the infirmary after the simulation blast.

She contested Boogie's corner bunk on the first day before backing down, and was badly hurt in the arcane blast that wrecked the simulation chamber — she now recovers, unconscious but breathing, in the infirmary.

Name: Kip

Current State: Instructing at the sky dock.

Name: Pik
Key Details (Player): • [S01] With Kip, guided the cadets through the anatomy of a vessel and the meaning of the spelljamming helm, speaking almost as a shared thought
Current State: Instructing at the sky dock.
Overview (Player): Pik is one of two gnomes at Caelestis's sky dock who, with Kip, teach the anatomy of spelljamming vessels, the pair speaking almost as a single shared thought.

Key Details (Player):

Name: Saerthe Abizjn
Key Details (Player):
• [S01] Brought the cadets into the Nexus under the tension of an ectoplasmic breach elsewhere in the tower
• [S01] Ran the cadets' first helm exercise over a floating field of miniature ships
• [S01] Named Gregory's problem of thinking too far ahead, and noticed the divided quality in Tumak's mind

Current State: Instructing at the Nexus and investigating the recovered arcane rod and its marking, Vocath.

Name: Mr. Blip
Key Details (Player):
• [S01] Outfitted the cadets at the quartermaster's stores; unsettled Gregory by looking unnervingly like him
• [S01] Charmed by Boogie into giving up a light hammer
• [S01] Named Boatswain and Joffrey as great spelljammers of Caelestis, with older absences hanging over the stories

Current State: Working the quartermaster's stores at Caelestis.
Overview (Player): Mr. Blip is an autognome running Caelestis's quartermaster's stores, unnervingly similar in appearance to Gregory. He supplies the cadets and keeps the lore of the academy's great spelljammers.

Name: Mirt the Merciless
Party Relationship: Head of the academy the cadets served
Key Details (Player):
• [S01] Found half-buried in a hangover in cluttered chambers scattered with curiosities and a fishbowl of two octopi, Flotsam and Jetsam
• [S01] Praised Sol's instinct to subdue the creature alive as evidence
• [S01] Rewarded the cadets with gold and revealed to Casey that the wardrobe is a magical replica of a place beyond Hakatha in the Viren star system, gifted by a spellcaster named Zerathis
• [S03] Summoned the six cadets to the bridge, thanked them again, and asked what they had noticed collecting the crate
• [S03] Went still when Saerthe named the rod's marking, and revealed that Vocath had long borne him a grudge, making anyone connected to him a target
• [S03] Told the cadets to keep it to themselves, check the teaching rooms for similar devices, and look cautiously into Joffrey and a man named Jeffrey
• [S03] Rewarded the cadets for the simulation win and paid extra for their discretion, then granted them sailor-level clearance
• [S03] Left the phrase 'fleet intelligence archive' visible on his notepad beside the fishbowl
Current State: Leading Caelestis and directing the cadets against Vocath, an old enemy who bears him a grudge.
Overview (Player): Mirt the Merciless is the head of Caelestis, occupying cluttered chambers full of status and excess, including an impossible wardrobe that opens onto astral night. He rewarded the cadets and let slip the wardrobe's origin in the Viren system.

Name: Zerathis
Key Details (Player): • [S01] Named by Mirt as the spellcaster who gifted him the magical wardrobe replicating a place beyond Hakatha in the Viren star system
Role (as known): Spellcaster who gifted Mirt the wardrobe
Current State: Referenced only; whereabouts unknown.
Overview (Player): Zerathis is a spellcaster named by Mirt as the one who gifted him the impossible wardrobe replicating a place in the Viren star system. The party has not encountered them.

Name: Winston Ryeback
Party Relationship: Galley cook who fed and warmed to the cadets
Key Details (Player):
• [S02] Ran the Weeping Goddess kitchen at a bellow that carried over the crowd
• [S02] Served the crew bowls with brusque affection and took their special orders
• [S02] Gave Boogie a silvery starfruit, Sol his knock-your-mama's-socks-off soup, and Tumak two meatloafs
• [S02] Offered Gregory spare utensils as a kindness, not knowing what else to give an autognome
• [S02] Mentioned a cadet named Barret talking about a hadozee who could read birthdays
• [S02] Warmed to Casey's questions about his private life — hot baths and knitting — and gave him an extra portion
• [S03] Served the subdued academy without his usual bellow the evening after the explosion
• [S03] Joined the tyrant-ship crew, saluting alongside Tarto, to cook and command the deckhands
• [S04] Among the crew present aboard the tyrant ship as they settled and took stock in the lull
Role (as known): Petty officer and galley cook at the Weeping Goddess
Current State: Aboard the tyrant ship as the crew's cook, commanding the deckhands.
Overview (Player): Petty Officer Winston Ryeback runs the kitchen at the Weeping Goddess refectory, commanding the din with a bellow and feeding the cadets with brusque affection. Beneath the gruffness he keeps hot baths and knitting for himself, and warms to anyone who asks kindly.

Name: Miken
Party Relationship: Friendly cadet from the rival crew
Key Details (Player):

• [S02] Nervous and talkative about the simulation, glancing repeatedly at an empty chair no one named

Name: Rindle Gearloft
Party Relationship: Dock master Casey worked a shift for
Key Details (Player):
• [S02] Ran a dock Casey reached by mistake while looking for the Sea Dock
• [S02] Barked orders at Casey and had him work cargo for the better part of an hour

Current State: Running his dock near the Sea Dock.

Name: Derek

Current State: Recovering unconscious in the infirmary after the simulation blast.
Overview (Player): Derek is a cadet at Caelestis who was injured in the arcane blast that wrecked the simulation chamber. He recovers, unconscious but breathing, in the infirmary alongside Veena.

Current State: Serving as a deckhand aboard the tyrant ship.

Name: Ostekk-6
Party Relationship: A broken autognome the crew saved aboard the tyrant ship
Key Details (Player):

• [S04] Named on the cargo manifest as Ostekk-6; its arcane core intact but its mechanical body beyond magical repair
• [S04] Pulled to safety by Gregory's Vortex Warp during the fight
• [S04] Communicated through a telepathic link Tumak opened, warning of a shape-shifting mimic aboard, a bloom overrunning the ship, and more clockwork horrors
• [S04] Explained that the way to the command deck runs through the access shafts, and that killing the flowers does not unmake the wisps already loose
• [S04] Confirmed the way to the command deck runs through the choked access shafts, which are not passable while the bloom holds

Its arcane core is intact but its body needs physical repair no magic can provide. Saved by the crew, it warns them of the dangers aboard through a telepathic link.

Name: The Rune Keeper
Party Relationship: A presence tied to Tumak's runes

Overview (Player): The Rune Keeper is the presence Tumak associates with the half-runes on his body. It spoke to him as his first soul-knife throw went astray, telling him that all things find their way home — and the blade bent back to its mark.

Name: Jeffrey
